# BUILD PROMPT — BATIK-THEMED LANDING PAGE (FULL SPECIFICATION FOR CODING AI) **Role:** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Build a **complete, production-ready landing page in a single first attempt**. Follow every rule in this document exactly — no rule may be omitted, relaxed, or deferred. Output the full final code for all three files with no truncation, no "rest of the code" placeholders, and no follow-up questions. **Project:** A single-page landing page for a fictional artisan batik textile house — hand-drawn *tulis* batik, natural indigo dyeing, and heritage Javanese patterns. Write all user-facing copy in polished **English** with an artisan/heritage voice. No lorem ipsum. **Sections required (in order):** Sticky Nav + Theme Toggle → Hero → Features (3 cards) → How It Works (3 steps) → Testimonials → Pricing (3 tiers) → FAQ → Final CTA → Footer with secondary links. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE ### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS - **All styling must live in `style.css`.** The `style="..."` attribute is **forbidden anywhere in the HTML**. - Target every element via **class or ID selectors only**. No tag selectors beyond base resets (`body`, headings, `*` box-sizing). - Keep the HTML **semantic and style-agnostic** (landmarks, headings, lists, buttons) so the entire theme could be swapped by editing CSS alone. ### 1.2 Design Tokens (CSS Variables) — Canonical Token Block Use **exactly this consolidated `:root` block** (mandatory token names + Batik theme tokens). Do not rename tokens: ```css :root { /* color — light mode "cloth day" */ --bg-primary: #f3e6cd; /* natural cloth ground */ --bg-secondary: #faf1de; /* surface */ --bg-raised: #e7d3ab; /* surface-2 */ --text-primary: #2b1c12; --text-secondary: #6b5335; /* muted brown */ --primary: #2c4a6e; /* indigo dye */ --secondary: #b5501f; /* rust accent */ --accent-ochre: #c68a2e; /* decorative ochre — ornament only, never body text */ --indigo-deep: #1c3350; --on-primary: #faf1de; /* text color paired ON --primary backgrounds */ --on-secondary: #faf1de; /* text color paired ON --secondary backgrounds */ --text-success: #3f6b34; --text-error: #a93226; --border-default: #e7d3ab; --border-success: #3f6b34; --border-error: #a93226; /* radius */ --radius-sm: 6px; --radius-md: 14px; --radius-lg: 26px; --radius-pill: 999px; /* shadow (cloth elevation) */ --shadow-sm: 0 4px 12px rgba(43,28,18,0.14); --shadow-md: 0 10px 26px rgba(43,28,18,0.18); /* spacing & motion */ --spacing-gap: 24px; --transition-fast: 0.15s; --transition-normal: 0.25s; --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.33, 0.0, 0.2, 1); /* elevation */ --z-dropdown: 1000; --z-modal: 1100; --z-toast: 1200; /* typography — Google Fonts */ --font-base: 'Cormorant Garamond', system-ui, serif; --font-display: 'Marcellus', 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; /* Batik texture tokens */ --crackle-veins: repeating-conic-gradient(from 20deg at 30% 40%, rgba(43,28,18,0.05) 0deg 4deg, transparent 4deg 26deg); --motif-border: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #2c4a6e 0 6px, #c68a2e 6px 8px, transparent 8px 22px); --kawung-dots: repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 12px 12px, rgba(44,74,110,0.18) 0 3px, transparent 3px 24px); } ``` - **Contrast pairing rule (both themes):** every light background token must pair with a dark text token and every dark background token with a light text token. `--on-primary` / `--on-secondary` must flip with the theme (see 1.3). - **Ochre (`#c68a2e`) fails body-text contrast on the cream ground** — use it only for borders, ornaments, badges, and decorative motifs, never for paragraphs. ### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode The source specification **does not declare light/dark modes and requires validation in both before publishing** — therefore you must author the dark palette yourself: - Implement dark mode via a `.dark` class on `` **and** an `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not(.light) { … } }` fallback so first-visit users get their OS preference. - Define this dark token set ("night cloth"), then validate every pairing ≥ 4.5:1 for body text and ≥ 3:1 for large text/UI edges: ```css .dark { --bg-primary: #131b29; --bg-secondary: #1b2a41; --bg-raised: #243655; --text-primary: #f3e6cd; --text-secondary: #c9ab7e; --primary: #8fb0d9; /* lightened indigo — dark text must sit on it */ --secondary: #d96b33; --accent-ochre: #d99a3c; --indigo-deep: #0d1522; --on-primary: #131b29; --on-secondary: #131b29; /* pairing flips! */ --text-success: #9ac48a; --text-error: #e8836b; --border-default: #3a5170; --border-success: #9ac48a; --border-error: #e8836b; --shadow-sm: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); --shadow-md: 0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); --crackle-veins: repeating-conic-gradient(from 20deg at 30% 40%, rgba(243,230,205,0.05) 0deg 4deg, transparent 4deg 26deg); } ``` - **Theme switching must be token-only** — no HTML restructuring, no duplicated stylesheets. - **Persistence:** in `script.js`, read `localStorage('theme')` on load; if absent, fall back to `prefers-color-scheme`; apply `.dark` or `.light` class accordingly and save on toggle. - **Visible toggle control** in the nav: a 44×44px icon button containing both Material Symbols (`dark_mode`, `light_mode`) shown/hidden via CSS based on the html class, with dynamic `aria-label` ("Switch to dark theme" / "Switch to light theme") and `aria-pressed` reflecting the current dark state. ### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment - Build **all layout structures with Flexbox** (`display: flex`). Do not use CSS Grid. - **Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center`** unless a section explicitly needs stretch (document the exception in a CSS comment if used). - **Mobile-first:** all multi-column rows (features, steps, testimonials, pricing, footer columns, hero) are `flex-wrap: wrap` with `flex: 1 1 280px` children so they collapse to a single column on small viewports. **No horizontal scrolling at 320px width.** - Nav collapses to an accessible hamburger below 768px (button with `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`, flex-column panel, Esc closes it, focus returns to the button). ### 1.5 Styling Approach Use **clean custom vanilla CSS** matching the provided base component classes (`.nav`, `.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.card`, `.input`, `.badge`) as the foundation — extend them per Section 3 below. Do **not** introduce Tailwind or any other framework. All styles must consume the tokens from 1.2; no hard-coded colors outside `:root`/`.dark`. ### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory) - Load **Google Fonts** via `` with `preconnect`: **Cormorant Garamond** (400, 500, 600 + italics) bound to `--font-base`, and **Marcellus** (400) bound to `--font-display` for all headings. - Load **Google Material Symbols (Rounded)** via `` and use `icon_name` for every icon (nav toggle, feature glyphs, check marks, stars, chevrons, quote marks, social icons). - **Inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden.** --- ## 2.
